title: Suwayomi
description: Keep the status and backlog of your Logged mangas in sync with the categories of your Suwayomi library.

connection.timesHint: Between 1 and 24. An interval of about {{hours}} h.
connection.importHint: Review and import the titles that are missing from Logged.
connection.includeInGlobalHint: When enabled, Suwayomi takes part in the global button and schedule.
connection.initialSyncHint: Initial sync pending. Sync now to send new titles to review.

auth.label: Authentication
auth.hint: Only Suwayomi's Basic auth is supported.
auth.required: Fill in both username and password.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Choose what each Suwayomi category becomes in Logged. When a manga is in more than one mapped category, the first one in this order wins.
categories.stale: Could not reach Suwayomi; showing the last known categories.

summary.title: Last result
summary.unmatchedHint: Resolve them in the pending links list below.

errors.invalidTimes: Choose between 1 and 24 syncs per day.
errors.load: Could not load the Suwayomi settings.
errors.save: Could not save the Suwayomi settings.

links.title: Pending links
links.description: Titles the sync could not link automatically. They also appear in Import → Automatic; here you can link one to an existing manga or ignore it.
links.pendingHint: Also available in Import → Automatic. The sync retries this title automatically.
links.ignoredHint: Ignored: the sync will not create or retry this title.
links.linked: Link created; the next sync applies the category.
links.ignored: Title ignored; the sync will not retry it.
links.restored: Title restored; the sync will try it again.
